      • Class ua.stetsenkoinna.graphnet.GraphCanvasModel

        class GraphCanvasModel extends Object implements Serializable
        serialVersionUID:
        1L

        • Serialized Fields

          • frames
            List<GraphObjectFrame> frames
          • fusions
            List<GraphPlaceFusion> fusions
          • groups
            List<GraphObjectGroup> groups
            Petri-objects stamped together from one net - see GraphObjectGroup.

            Held beside the frames rather than instead of them. A group's members are ordinary objects on this canvas and stay in GraphCanvasModel.frames; this list only records which of them were made together, which is all a group is.

          • loadWarnings
            List<String> loadWarnings
            What had to be dropped from the document this canvas was read from, if anything.

            A file can carry links the editor would never have allowed to be drawn - a pair linked both ways round, a place copying two sources, a loop - because a document is built by a writer, by hand, or by an older version of this tool, none of which consulted these rules. Such links are left out and named here rather than silently drawn, which is how one of them came to be noticed on screen in the first place.

          • name
            String name
          • net
            GraphPetriNet net

        • Serialized Fields

          • bounds
            Rectangle bounds
          • collapsed
            boolean collapsed
          • contentVisible
            boolean contentVisible
          • enclosing
            GraphObjectFrame enclosing
            The object that encloses this one, or null when it sits directly on the net.

            Kept on the frame rather than in a side table on GraphCanvasModel because "what claims me" already lives here, so "what encloses me" belongs next to it, and because the web editor models the same relation the same way (an object frame naming its parent object). Written only by GraphCanvasModel.nest(ua.stetsenkoinna.graphnet.GraphObjectFrame, ua.stetsenkoinna.graphnet.GraphObjectFrame), which is the one place that can check for a cycle.

          • expandedBounds
            Rectangle expandedBounds
            Bounds the frame had before it was collapsed, so expanding restores them.

      • Class ua.stetsenkoinna.graphnet.GraphObjectGroup

        class GraphObjectGroup extends Object implements Serializable
        serialVersionUID:
        1L

        • Serialized Fields

          • members
            List<GraphObjectFrame> members
            The members, in the order they were stamped.

            Order is part of what a group is: list_i is the i-th instance's parameters, and "the third server" has to keep meaning the same object across a save and a reload.

          • modelId
            String modelId
          • name
            String name
          • template
            NetTemplateRef template
            Where the shared net came from, when it came from the net library.

            Provenance only, and null for a group stamped from an object the user drew by hand. The nets themselves are stored in full on each member, exactly as they are for a lone object, so a group opens even when the library method behind it is gone.

        • Serialized Fields

          • absoluteLayout
            boolean absoluteLayout
            True when this object's net still carries the exact canvas coordinates it was exported with, so a reader must keep them instead of normalizing and re-centring. Set by the PNML parser for documents this application wrote; foreign documents keep the defensive normalization and auto-layout.
          • collapsed

          • contentVisible
            Boolean contentVisible
          • graphNet
            GraphPetriNet graphNet
          • height
            int height
          • modelId
            String modelId
          • name
            String name
          • parentIndex
            int parentIndex
            The index of the object this one is nested inside, or -1 for a top-level object.

            The model's only carrier of the canvas's nesting. A document states it by writing the inner object's page inside the outer one's; before that it was flattened to sibling pages, and reimporting lost the nest: the inner object came back sitting geometrically inside the outer frame while structurally belonging to nobody, so dragging the outer object left it behind.

            Point position
          • priority
            int priority

            NetTemplateRef template

      • Class ua.stetsenkoinna.graphnet.GraphPlaceFusion

        class GraphPlaceFusion extends Object implements Serializable
        serialVersionUID:
        1L

        • Serialized Fields

          • boundaryStubOffset
            Point2D.Double boundaryStubOffset
            Where the user parked this shared place's boundary stub on an object's own canvas, as an offset from the drawn half's centre - null until the user drags it, which means "derived: a short stub pointing toward the off-canvas half".
          • joined
            GraphPetriPlace joined
          • joinedOwner
            GraphObjectFrame joinedOwner
          • master
            GraphPetriPlace master
          • masterOwner
            GraphObjectFrame masterOwner
            Which Petri-object each half belongs to, remembered when the two were joined.

            Everywhere else on the canvas the frame an element is drawn in decides which object owns it. A shared place is the one case where that cannot work: the two halves sit on top of each other, so they are drawn in the same frame while belonging to two objects. Null means the half belongs to no frame — the free elements.

            Not final: ownership changes after the join (the owning object is ungrouped, a half is dragged into another object), and a snapshot frozen at join time kept the fusion anchored to a frame that was no longer on the canvas. GraphCanvasModel refreshes these from the claims whenever ownership moves.
